CustomField.label: Duration
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(ISBLANK(Execution_Start__c), ISBLANK(Execution_End__c)), "", TEXT(FLOOR((Execution_End__c - Execution_Start__c) * 24 * 60)) & "m " & TEXT(ROUND(MOD((Execution_End__c - Execution_Start__c) * 24 * 60 * 60, 60), 0)) & "s")
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Wall-clock time from first batch to last.
